notes.title: Patch note : Version 0.7.3
notes.notes:
Rework ⚙️
- Incendiary and electricity modules: damage is now more evenly distributed over time.
- Bounce Module: from now on, the bounce effect has a percentage chance of being applied to the projectile.
- Smasher: the blast area from the explosion module has been rebalanced.
- Kraken: the alien hit points has been rebalanced.

Bug fixes ⚒️ 
- Kraken: Fixed a bug that caused the player to die when using a special skill against the Kraken.
- Kraken: Fixed a bug that prevented the player from playing a new game after killing the Kraken.
- Gravity Module: Fixed a bug that caused aliens to leave the game area.
- Options: Fixed a bug that did not apply sound option changes correctly.
- Meta Progression: Fixed a bug that caused the player's meta-progression to reset.
- Endless mode: Fixed a bug that prevented the penalties to apply correctly.
- Endless mode: Add the following penalties: fire resistance, electrical resistance, corrosive rain

New features⭐️
- Added a timer to the infinite mode.

notes.title: Original Soundtracks Release
notes.notes:
John never goes on an expedition without his good old radio!

The soundtrack of THE LAST HUMAN IS A BIKER contains 6 tracks of music from the game, composed by the incredible band PVLSΛR.

The digital version will be available on Steam on May 4, 2023, at the price of 1€99.

Steam product page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2345260

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.notes:
[D-30 🧨

It's official! THE LAST HUMAN IS A BIKER will be released in early access on Thursday, May 4th 2023 at 18:00 CEST.

ℹ️ This version will be sold for $1.99 on the Steam only, and will be available for Windows and MacOS.

Disclaimer: 
Early access means that the game is only partially finished. We are offering our players the opportunity to participate in its development by analyzing their feedback through numerous future updates. Only buy this version if you want to play the game before official release or actively support the developers.

notes.title: Patch note - Version 0.5.1
notes.notes:
Balancing📊

- Vengeance progression (experience points) : you gain sightly more points from early aliens

- Bounce lvl 1: no change
- Bounce lvl 2:+50 range, +1 bounce => 75% range, +0 bounce
- Bounce lvl 3: +75% range, +1 bounce => 50% range, +1 bounce
- Bounce lvl 4 : +100% range, +1 bounce => 75% range, +0 bounce
- Bounce lvl 5: +150% range, +1 bounce => 50% range, +1 bounce

- Fast reload lvl 1 : no change
- Fast reload lvl 2 : fast reload +10% => fast recharge +15
- Fast reload lvl 3 : no change
- Fast reload : fast reload +10% => fast recharge 15%
- Fast reload lvl 3 : no change
- Fast reload lvl 5 : no change


New features ⭐️

- New voices in English version
- Improved garage ergonomics

notes.title: Patch note - Version 0.5.0
notes.notes:
New features ⭐️:
- The game is now playable with a controller ! 
- new scenery: buildings, smoke, sky and weather
- 6 new weapon modules: electricity, incendiary, fast reload, velocity, duplication, bounce
- 1 new motorcycle: The Turismo
- New UI Friendly elements in the menus
- New visual effects on explosions and flamethrower
- New « burning » status
- New « shocked » status
- New English voices

Fixes  :
- Fixed a bug that caused a spire (flying snakes) to persist on the screen after being eliminated.
- Fixed a bug that caused the weapon selection menu to crash
